svg.desc: Four rungs of openness rather than two. Fully open releases weights, data, code and checkpoints, like OLMo, and could be retrained. Open weights releases the weights and a licence but withholds data and code, like Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek and gpt-oss. Open weights with a restricted licence limits who may use them or how. Closed models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok offer an API, a price list and a system card, and publish no parameter count at all.
